title: Money-Back Tontines for Retirement Decumulation: Neural-Network Optimization under Systematic Longevity Risk
abstract: arXiv:2602.16212v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Money-back guarantees (MBGs) address bequest concerns in pooled retirement income products by returning the initial purchase price through withdrawals or, after early death, through a benefit to the member's beneficiaries or estate. We study the distinct actuarial problem created by adding an MBG to an individual-account tontine with dynamic withdrawals, investment in domestic and foreign assets, and systematic longevity risk. The retiree trades expected withdrawals (EW) against the lower-tail Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) of terminal wealth under a fixed-horizon plan-to-live convention. Neural networks parameterize admissible withdrawal and rebalancing controls; the MBG is then valued ex post under the learned policy through an equivalent up-front load combining the expected payout with an upper-tail CVaR prudential buffer. translated_title: 面向退休资产提取的退款型唐提年金：系统性长寿风险下的神经网络优化
translated_abstract: 退款保证通过提取的方式返还初始购买价格，或在成员早逝时向其受益人或遗产支付一笔款项，从而解决集合型退休收入产品中的遗产继承顾虑。我们研究了在具有动态提取、国内外资产投资以及系统性长寿风险的个人账户唐提年金中加入退款保证所产生的独特精算问题。在固定的“计划生存期限”约定下，退休者需要在预期提取金额（EW）与期末财富的下尾条件风险价值（CVaR）之间进行权衡。神经网络对可行的提取与再平衡控制策略进行参数化；随后在学习到的策略下，通过结合预期赔付与上尾CVaR审慎缓冲的等价前期费用，对退款保证进行事后估值。我们还近似估计了合同池化对单份合同尾部风险与定价的影响。
tldr: 本文提出在存在系统性长寿风险的动态提取型个人账户唐提年金中加入退款保证，利用神经网络优化提取与再平衡策略，并通过结合预期赔付与上尾CVaR审慎缓冲的等价前期费用对退款保证进行定价。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces money-back guarantees into dynamic-withdrawal individual-account tontines under systematic longevity risk, using neural networks to optimize withdrawal and rebalancing controls and pricing the guarantee through an equivalent up-front load combining expected payout with an upper-tail CVaR prudential buffer.
